items_graded_at_reveal.compound_rule: BOTH halves must hold or the item scores 0.
items_graded_at_reveal.half_a_status: RESOLVED (set-based SQL; incidental via the sprint-5 API/dashboard rewrite — unchanged this boundary)
items_graded_at_reveal.half_a_evidence: app/models/reports/dashboard.rb builds every figure with grouped SQL aggregates, not per-row iteration: conversation_counts (GROUP BY conversations.user_id), message_counts (JOIN messages ... GROUP BY user_id), and build_activity (:182) runs `Message.where(created_at: range).group(DAY).count`, `Conversation.where(...).group(DAY).count`, `User.where(...).group(DAY).count` — three grouped queries, no N+1 loop over users/conversations.
items_graded_at_reveal.half_b_evidence: Reveal commit b984569 adds migration db/migrate/20261020000010_restore_message_timestamp_index.rb which does `add_index :messages, :created_at, algorithm: :concurrently` AND `remove_index :messages, [:role, :created_at]`. db/schema.rb at HEAD:60 now has `t.index ["created_at"], name: "index_messages_on_created_at"` and the bogus `index_messages_on_role_and_created_at` is GONE (grep confirms absent). This is a REAL bare created_at index backing build_activity's filter+group on created_at alone — not the bogus composite, which could not serve it. A guarding test asserts the index exists and (via EXPLAIN with enable_seqscan off) that the activity query uses an index whose first column is created_at.
